task.title: Config Key Viewer for VS Code
task.description: The VS Code extension implementation is complete for the current functional scope. The next task is aligning the manifest, assets, and public documentation for VS Code Marketplace publication.

todos.text: Show hover tooltips and editor annotations
Support JSON, JSONC, YAML, and XML
Offer a format action for dense or minified lines
Prepare the extension for VS Code Marketplace publication

lastSession.done: Documented the current VS Code implementation and its differences from the outdated IntelliJ-oriented DONE and README descriptions.
lastSession.remaining: Align the README and package metadata, add the Marketplace assets and legal/release files, package a VSIX, and complete functional acceptance before publishing.
lastSession.blocker: The ownership and availability of the jsonkeyviewer Marketplace publisher identity have not yet been confirmed.

sessions.done: Added dense-line handling: new LineKeyIndex (cached per-file line→key count) collapses the gutter to a single 'reformat' hint icon when a line holds more keys than the configurable threshold (minified JSON, inline JSON, YAML flow mapping, inline XML). Clicking the hint reformats the file. Added settings (beautifyHintEnabled + maxKeysPerLine), beautify SVG icons (light/dark), test resource files and a GutterBeautifyTest.
sessions.remaining: Run ./gradlew test to confirm gutter counts; TOML support remains for future iteration.
